title: Clear- Great location, comfortable family home.
description:
Convenience at its finest! This centrally-located home puts you and your family within easy reach of everything you need.

Enjoy hassle-free travel with I-24 just around the corner, connecting you to Nashville and Murfreesboro in no time.

Plus, indulge in the ultimate convenience with:

Groceries just minutes away
A variety of restaurants to suit every taste
Gas stations to fuel up on the go
Shopping centers for some retail therapy

Make the most of your stay in this perfectly positioned home!"

The space
Thoughtfully designed for comfort and convenience, this home provides; 

*Private Bedrooms Upstairs*
All three bedrooms are nestled on the 2nd floor, providing a peaceful retreat for rest and relaxation.

*Convenient Main Living Areas*
The 1st floor is dedicated to open living, with:

- Half bath for guests
- Laundry room for added convenience

Perfect for families, roommates, or anyone seeking a functional living space.

Guest access
You have access to the whole house.

Other things to note
This home isn't newly built and has expected wear and tear from being utilized as a short-term rental. Currently the garage is unavailable.
